title: RawGlobalSynthesis
description: The global synthesis as the model emits it, written to ./synthesis.json. Mirrors internal/insights.RawGlobalSynthesis field-for-field: no generated_at/window/repos envelope and no per-finding repos/session_count/last_seen/acted_key — Go computes all of those.

meta.description: Go-owned: the model id is stamped and validation_notes are appended by the verifier. Omit.

rank.description: 1 = highest leverage. Ranks across findings form a 1..N permutation, N <= 10.

title.description: Imperative browsing handle, at most 40 characters, no trailing period, no numbers.

rank_rationale.description: One sentence: why this finding sits at this rank. No numbers.

audience.description: Who must see the asset for it to bind. REQUIRED for claude_md_rule and repo_doc; optional otherwise.

items.description: Repo-namespaced bundle id exactly as the bundle files carry it, e.g. alpha/F3.

quotes.description: Verbatim copies from cited items' quote fields (or a cited signal's detail lines). Never paraphrased.

escalated_from.description: Present iff this finding escalates an existing rule (never on habit): the pre-existing rule being strengthened. The asset is then the enforcement/placement change, typed by its own ladder rung.

target.description: Destination: file path, skill name, or settings key. Omitted only for habit.

content.description: The exact deliverable, ready to apply: rule lines, skill outline, hook guard. Omitted only for habit.

verdict.description: Is the proposed asset already in place at its target? yes requires source_path + verbatim excerpt.

excerpt.description: Verbatim copy of the existing rule from source_path.

reason.description: Why no asset earns its keep. No numbers.
